items.source: Construct an empty CompositeCacheManager, with delegate CacheManagers to be added via the "cacheManagers" property.
items.translation: 构建一个空的 `CompositeCacheManager`，并通过 `"cacheManagers"` 属性添加委托的 `CacheManager`。

items.source: Note: Regular CacheManagers that this composite manager delegates to need to return null from getCache(String) if they are unaware of the specified cache name, allowing for iteration to the next delegate in line. However, most CacheManager implementations fall back to lazy creation of named caches once requested; check out the specific configuration details for a 'static' mode with fixed cache names, if available.
items.translation: 注意：此组合管理器委托的常规 CacheManagers 需要在其未意识到指定缓存名称时，从getCache(String)返回null，以便迭代到下一位代理。然而，大多数CacheManager实现会在请求后回退到懒创建命名缓存；如果可用，请查看特定配置详情以获取“静态”模式（具有固定缓存名称）。

items.source: Allows NoOpCacheManager to be automatically added to the end of the list for handling cache declarations without a backing store. Otherwise, any custom CacheManager may play that role of the last delegate as well, lazily creating cache regions for any requested name.
items.translation: 允许将 `NoOpCacheManager` 自动添加到处理无后端存储的缓存声明列表末尾。否则，任何自定义的 `CacheManager` 也可以担任最后一个委托的角色，并为任何请求的名称懒式创建缓存区域。

items.source: Indicate whether a NoOpCacheManager should be added at the end of the delegate list. In this case, any getCache requests not handled by the configured CacheManagers will be automatically handled by the NoOpCacheManager (and hence never return null).
items.translation: 指示是否在委托列表末尾添加一个NoOpCacheManager。在这种情况下，任何未被配置的 CacheManagers 处理的getCache请求都将自动由NoOpCacheManager处理（因此永远不会返回null）。

items.source: Indicate whether a NoOpCacheManager should be added at the end of the delegate list.
items.translation: 指示是否在委托列表末尾添加一个 `NoOpCacheManager`。

items.source: Construct a CompositeCacheManager from the given delegate CacheManagers.
items.translation: 从给定的委托 CacheManagers 构建一个 CompositeCacheManager。

items.source: Get a collection of the cache names known by this manager.
items.translation: 获取此管理器已知的缓存名称集合。

items.source: Specify the CacheManagers to delegate to.
items.translation: 指定要委托的 CacheManagers。

items.source: cacheManagers - the CacheManagers to delegate to
items.translation: cacheManagers - 要委托的缓存管理器

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
Note that the cache may be lazily created at runtime if the
native provider supports it.
items.translation: 请注意，如果原生提供者支持，缓存可能会在运行时懒加载创建。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。
